ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This face-to-face course for students in the Macomb cohort begins on Monday August 22nd and ends on December 5th. The face-to-face classes will be held from 6:00 to 8:50 PM each Monday. The location of the face-to-face sessions will be Horrabin Hall Room 21, Western Illinois University, 1 University Circle, Macomb, IL 61455.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $452.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
